groups.name: Warm-Up
groups.intro: Before every game, and before practice when there's time. Short on time? Pick 3 to 5 of these.
groups.when: Before every game, no exceptions. Before practice too when there is time. Short on time? Pick 3 to 5 of the exercises.

workouts.name: Warm-Up
workouts.how: Do this warm-up before team practices. Before games it's a MUST. Short on time before practice? Choose 3-5 of the exercises. · 1-2 sets of each · 10-15 reps each.

groups.name: Mobility
groups.intro: 5 to 10 minutes. Before or after practice, or on an off day.
groups.when: 2 to 3 times a week, 5 to 10 minutes. In season: before practice on practice days. Off season: on off days or your own training day. This is not a workout, it attaches to one.

workouts.name: Mobility Workout
workouts.how: 2 sets of each exercise · 10 reps per side.
workouts.when: before or after practices and games, or on off days.

groups.name: Stretching
groups.intro: After practice, after games, or on off days. Always finish with the MAT holds so the muscles wake back up.
groups.when: Recovery, 2 to 3 times a week, 5 to 10 minutes. After practice, after a game, or on an off day. Always finish with the MAT Holds.

workouts.name: Stretching
workouts.how: 1-2 sets of each stretch · 5-10 reps per side · always finish with the MAT exercises.

groups.name: MAT Holds
groups.intro: Do these right after stretching. Stretching relaxes the muscles; these turn them back on.
groups.when: Right after stretching, every time. Stretching relaxes the muscles; these turn them back on.

workouts.name: MAT Holds
workouts.how: 1 set of each exercise · 6 reps · hold each rep for 6 SECONDS · both sides (6 reps of 6 seconds per side).

exercises.name: Hip Flexion with External Rotation Iso
Hip Flexion with Internal Rotation Iso

groups.name: Stability & Balance
groups.intro: Off-season: 2 a week. In season: 1 a week still helps. Master the Disc version before moving up to the BOSU.
groups.when: In season: 1 workout a week, this or a Foundation workout. Off season: 2 workouts a week, one Stability and one Foundation. Never the day before a game.

workouts.name: Stability Workout 1
workouts.how: 2-3 sets · 10-15 reps per exercise (each side when it's one leg at a time) · rest 60-90 seconds between sets · master the Disc version before moving up to the BOSU.
workouts.when: Off-season: 2 times a week · In season: even 1 time a week will help · You can mix it with the Core Edge · You can mix it with strength exercises to make a full workout.
